svg.text: TANSTAAFLLM video: picture and the music wanted (94 s)
Hatched: reading holds, where the picture rests. Colour = mood of each movement. Times in seconds of the final cut.
hits; the hold is a suspended
playful groove; a blip per stat;
half-time under the mission text; the
hold breathes on a bass pedal, then a
menu theme; each card adds a layer, cheap to expensive;
banner impact; the hold resolves the theme
dark minor, alarm, double-time feel; pitch rises as the bar fills;
peak at the limit; the hold decays to a heartbeat
steady, confident march; tiles as a rising arpeggio; one stamp per rule;
fast and bright; a jump and a clear jingle
per stage; holds carry the fanfare's tail
